title: Kendine nazik ol

characters.WOMAN: a young woman with short wavy auburn hair, wearing a mustard sweater
characters.FRIEND: her friend, a young woman with long black braided hair in a teal jacket

scenes.text: Kendine, en sevdiğin arkadaşına davrandığın gibi davran.
scenes.prompt: {WOMAN} looks at her own reflection in a rainy café window, thoughtful and a little tired, warm interior lights.
In a cozy kitchen, {FRIEND} has dropped a cake on the floor and looks upset, while {WOMAN} laughs kindly and puts a hand on her shoulder.
Under a big autumn tree in a park, {FRIEND} rests on a picnic blanket with closed eyes while {WOMAN} sits beside her reading a book, leaves falling.
On a sofa in a warm living room, {WOMAN} hugs {FRIEND}, who is crying softly, a cup of tea on the table, soft lamp light.
{WOMAN} sits alone by a window wrapped in a soft blanket with a cup of tea, smiling gently at her reflection, morning sun, plants on the sill.

caption:
Başkalarına gösterdiğin şefkati kendine de göster. 🤍

Bunu kendine en sert davranan arkadaşına gönder.
